watch.en: Cover the pot and cook at a very low simmer, with the liquid reaching one third to one half of the food.
watch.de: Den Topf zudecken und bei ganz schwacher Hitze köcheln lassen; die Flüssigkeit reicht bis zu einem Drittel bis zur Hälfte des Garguts.

why.en: Heat, time and moisture break down the tough connective tissue of the meat until a fork cuts it.
why.de: Hitze, Zeit und Feuchtigkeit bauen das zähe Bindegewebe des Fleisches ab, bis es sich mit der Gabel schneiden lässt.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: the braising liquid will cover one-third to one-half of the food in the pan.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: The dish is then covered and cooked at a very low simmer until the meat becomes so tender

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Braising relies on heat, time, and moisture to break down the tough connective tissue (collagen) that binds together the muscle fibers
